scheme_name: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme for Working Women
other_conditions: Applicant must know how to drive and possess a valid Two Wheeler/Learner License Registration (LLR) at the time of applying
If applying with a Learner License, a valid Two Wheeler Driving License must be obtained before submitting the subsidy claim form
Applicant must attach a copy of the Two Wheeler Driving License with the claim form and produce the original for verification when required
Applicant must have appeared for the class 8th examination (passed or failed)
Only one woman per family is eligible for the benefit

Priority is given to women residing in remote or hilly areas, women‑headed households, deserted women, destitute widows, differently‑abled women, unmarried women above 35 years, Scheduled Caste/Tribe members, and transgender persons
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50% subsidy (maximum ₹25,000) for a gearless/auto‑geared two‑wheeler to eligible working women.
documents_required: Copy of Two Wheeler Driving License
